UCI does not charge and application fee, but this program is applied to via LSAC, and there are payable LSAC application fees.

The LL.M. program at UCI Law offers a rigorous academic program in a collegial, welcoming environment. University of California, Irvine students benefit from learning and mentorship in a close community of scholars, including world-renowned faculty. University of California, Irvine global LL.M. students have access to a full array of practical opportunities including clinics, student journals, externships, and more. All of this in Irvine - America’s safest city for 16 years - in beautiful Southern California.
